name: Latin America

labor_laws: Argentina: Ley de Contrato de Trabajo

work_culture.communication: Relationship-first. Warm, personal. Formal titles used (Licenciado, Doctor). Portuguese in Brazil, Spanish elsewhere.
work_culture.hierarchy: Moderate to high hierarchy. Respect for seniority. Personal relationships matter more than process.
work_culture.hours: 44 hours norm (some countries). Extended lunch (Brazil 1-2hrs). Office presence expected at growing companies.
work_culture.remote: Growing rapidly. Brazil/Mexico are major nearshoring destinations. Remote-first culture in tech startups.
work_culture.diversity_focus: Race/gender diversity growing. Class/economic inequality is a major factor. LGBTQ+ protections vary by country.

industry_context.saas: Brazil dominant ($5B+ market). Mexico growing. Argentina strong dev talent. Nubank (Brazil) is global fintech case study.
industry_context.fintech: Nubank, PicPay, Mercado Pago. Brazil leads LATAM fintech. Mexico fintech law 2018. Argentina crypto adoption high.
industry_context.healthcare: Mixed public/private systems. Brazil SUS (public). Mexico IMSS. Growing healthtech investment.
industry_context.manufacturing: Mexico manufacturing hub (automotive/aerospace). Brazil industrial base. Nearshoring from US growing.
industry_context.ecommerce: MercadoLibre dominant. Magazine Luiza, Americanas (Brazil). Growing social commerce. Cross-border buying common.

currency: BRL / MXN / ARS / COP / CLP / PEN
reporting_standards: IFRS (most) / Mexico: NIF / Brazil: CPC/IFRS converged
